cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(EXACT_TARGET STREQUAL "c")
  project(exact_tasks LANGUAGES C)
else()
  project(exact_tasks LANGUAGES CXX)
endif()
find_package(LeanBridgeLbcWide CONFIG REQUIRED)
add_executable(exact consumer.${EXACT_TARGET})
target_link_libraries(exact PRIVATE LeanBridge::lbc_wide)
